query:
WITH 14 AS active_days, ["browser_store", "dpapi_material", "cloud_cli", "remote_access", "developer_secret", "password_vault"] AS sensitive_categories
MATCH p=(u:User)-[h:HasUserProfile]->(c:Computer)<-[fo:FoundOn]-(a:ProfileArtifact)<-[:HasProfileArtifact]-(u)
WHERE h.profileModified > (datetime().epochSeconds - (active_days * 86400)) AND a.category IN sensitive_categories AND (fo.profilepath = h.path OR h.path IN coalesce(fo.profilepaths, []))
RETURN p
name: Profilehound - Sensitive Artifacts on Active Profiles
description: Shows sensitive artifact categories found on profiles modified within the configured number of days.
